Chalo, main batati hoon. Kitchen mein mummy roti ke hisse kabhi chhote kaatti hain, kabhi mila deti hain. Roti utni hi rehti hai. Upar 1/3 rangeen hai. Neeche har hissa 2 mein kata: 6 mein se 2, yaani 2/6. Rang utna hi hai, toh yeh tulya bhinn hain. Ab socho, is 3/4 wali patti ke har hisse ko 3 barabar hisson mein kaata. Sahi, 4: 8 aur 12 dono 4 barabar bade hisson mein mil jaate hain. Pehli patti ke do-do hisse milaye: 4 bade hisse bane, aur 6 rangeen mil kar 3. Tumhari baari: doosri patti ke 12 hisse bhi 4 bade hisson mein milao. Ab 4 mein se kitne bade hisse rangeen hain?

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 12 hisse karne ke liye har hissa 2 mein kata, toh 5 hisse 5 × 2 = 10 chhote hisson ke barabar. Farhan ne pizza ke 3 barabar hisson mein se 1 khaaya. Ritu ka waisa hi pizza 9 barabar hisson mein kata hai. Farhan se zyada khaane ke liye Ritu kam se kam kitne hisse khaaye?

Haan, bilkul theek. Suno, Farhan ka 1 hissa 9 wale pizza ke 3 hisson jitna hai; usse zyada ke liye kam se kam 4 hisse. Ab yahi kaatna aur milana upar aur neeche ke numbers par karenge: kaatna guna se, aur milana bhaag se. Yahan tak saaf hai?
aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
chauka

Achha, toh tumhe chauka sabse achha lagta hai. Ab apni padhai par lautte hain. Pehle 3/4 ke har hisse ko 3 mein kaata tha: neeche 4 × 3 = 12, upar 3 × 3 = 9. Upar aur neeche ko ek hi number se guna kiya, toh bhinn utna hi raha. Ab 3/4 ke barabar aisa bhinn chahiye jiska neeche 20 ho. Upar kaunsa number aayega?
